title: Terms of use
description: The rules for using he4rt ink: who can have an account, how review works and what happens to what you publish.

summary.title: Accounts from age 16
summary.text: Reading is free; to write and comment, confirm your email.

summary.title: Every article is reviewed
summary.text: Review takes up to 6 hours. You can resubmit whenever you want.

summary.title: Your text stays yours
summary.text: You allow us to show it here while it's published.

summary.title: Rules apply to everyone
summary.text: Anyone who breaks the Content policy may be suspended or banned.

blocks.p: When you create an account, you accept these Terms and the [Privacy policy](route:policies.privacy). We record the date and the versions accepted.
You declare you are 16 or older. You don't need an account to read.

list: Use an email that is yours and confirm it within 7 days; unconfirmed accounts are deleted.
Without confirmation you can read and write drafts, but you can't submit for review, like or comment.
You are responsible for your password and for what is done with your account.
A username may be refused if it breaks the [Content policy](route:policies.content).
Every submitted article is reviewed before it goes live. Review takes up to 6 hours.
The submitted version is frozen while it's in the queue. You can withdraw it and edit.
If the article isn't approved, you get the reason and the Content policy item. You can fix it and resubmit with no limit on attempts.
A published article may be unpublished if it breaks the Content policy, always with a reason.

blocks.p: What you write stays yours. By publishing, you allow he4rt ink to display, store and share the content on the platform, without payment and without exclusivity.
You guarantee you have the right to publish the texts, code and images you send, and you credit the sources of what isn't yours.

list: Penalties are: rejecting or unpublishing the article, temporary suspension and ban.
Every decision states the Content policy item that was broken.
You can appeal a suspension or ban. If the appeal is accepted, the account comes back right away.

blocks.p: You can delete your account in Settings. It stays in a 20-day grace period: logging in during that time lets you cancel. After that, deletion is permanent and your published articles become anonymous.
Articles express the opinion of whoever wrote them. Review checks the Content policy; it doesn't guarantee that every piece of code or information is right for your case.
We may change or stop parts of the platform, giving notice in advance whenever possible.
When the Terms change, we tell you by email and ask for a new acceptance at your next login. Questions: [{contact_email}](mailto:{contact_email}).
